description: Read-only questions over a fictional team notes workspace. Answers are stable because they refer to closed projects and past dates.

questions.question: Among the notes tagged for the mobile launch written before July 2025, which author wrote the most notes? Give the display name only.
The retrospective of the project whose codename is a bird of prey lists one unresolved action item. What is the due date of that item, formatted YYYY-MM-DD?
How many distinct folders contain at least one note that mentions the vendor contract renewal discussed in the second quarter of 2025? Answer with a number.
Find the decision record that rejected the self-hosted search engine. Which alternative was chosen? Answer with the product name only.
In the onboarding checklist last edited in 2025, what is the title of the step that comes right after setting up two-factor authentication?
Which note in the finance folder has the earliest creation date? Give its title exactly as stored.
True or false: the incident review for the March 2025 preview outage names a configuration change as the cause. Answer True or False.
The weekly status notes of the platform squad in February 2025 mention one external dependency as blocked every week. What is the name of that dependency?
How many notes carry both the tag for hiring and the tag for the Lyon office? Answer with a number.
Which tag is applied to the largest number of notes across the whole workspace? Give the tag name without the hash sign.
The product brief for the marketplace beta lists a target number of invited customers. What is that number?
